title: OmniRoute: Free AI Gateway with 268+ Providers in One Endpoint
description:
OmniRoute is a free, open-source AI gateway that connects your coding tools to 268+ providers through a single local endpoint. It auto-falls back when quota runs out, compresses prompts to save up to 95% on tokens, and shows your free usage on a live dashboard. Works with Cursor, Claude Code, and more.
